title: Senior Application Security Engineer
original_description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer.

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec, but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

  • Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

  • Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

  • Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

  • Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

  • Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

  • Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

  • Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

  • Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

  • Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

  • Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Research Engineer, GPU Performance
original_description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

title: Senior Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
original_description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA. If you’re someone who is excited and driven by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

Sales Cycle Ownership

  • Coplan and execute discovery calls to understand customer requirements, their technical environment, and current business challenges.

  • Design and deliver compelling demonstrations that solve customer problems, quantify the value of solving those problems, and tell a clear, credible story of how Synthesia solves them better than anything else.

  • Understand and overcome technical objections and integration concerns; identify blockers early and develop solution paths with customers.

  • Support stakeholder workshops that connect Synthesia to the buyer's broader technology strategy on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Partner with Account Executives to define account and deal strategy, advise on competitive positioning, and provide your assessment of opportunity stage and forecast your book of business to leadership.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable Demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, designing Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively empower executive champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objections, and industry playbooks brought to life directly in Synthesia’s platform.

  • Support POC and pilot readouts as a business narrative, not a feature tour, learning to bring storytelling and executive presence to the room as you grow into more senior conversations.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain deep expertise on Synthesia's platform capabilities across all product lines, roadmap, and positioning to highlight value driving use cases.

  • Specific vertical knowledge, establishing credibility as a subject matter expert within an industry to easily build credibility and trust with executive buyers.

  • Share customer and prospect product and competitive feedback to the pre-sales leadership and Product team; flag customer pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in live deals.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from current, static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

  • Enablement: Review and enhance enablement content from what is effective in preparing our team members for client engagements, delivering and evaluating certification as needed to accelerate understanding in the commercial team.

What we are looking for

  • We think the ideal candidate for this role will bring 5+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience at SaaS companies.

  • Strong consultative discovery, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both executive decision-makers (CHRO, CLO, Head of L&D, CTO) and technical audiences (IT, security, developers).

  • Technical depth in at least one area: Creation flows, APIs, integrations (LMS, HCM, CRM, identity), security, compliance; willingness to learn quickly across domains.

  • Fluency with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message. Comfort translating technical requirements into business value and ROI conversations.

  • Consultative approach to problem-solving; comfort gathering requirements, asking clarifying questions, and adapting solutions to customer needs.

  • Excellent business and technical presentation skills, in person and remote, and the ability to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Self-motivated and organized; ability to manage multiple POCs, demos, and customer conversations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborative mindset; thrives working with AEs, Product, Customer Success, and other teams to drive customer and company success.

  • Product orientation; genuine curiosity about how customers use technology

  • Willing to travel; willingness to visit key customers for discovery, executive conversations, and on-site demos.

Location

We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. Please confirm where you are located and whether you can spend two days a week in either location.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
original_description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities  

  • Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo:

    • Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking.

  • Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase:

    • Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure.

  • Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model:

    • Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware.

  • Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down.

  • Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases.

  • Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling.

  • Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them.

  • Review code, mentor colleagues on engineering practices, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience 

  • Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including a significant portion building infrastructure or tooling used by machine learning teams, such as an ML platform or a training framework (required).

  • Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required).

  • Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required).

  • Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required).

  • Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required).

  • Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required).

  • Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required).

  • Medical imaging experience (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images) (preferred).

  • HPC and Slurm experience (preferred).

  • Contributions to open-source ML tooling (preferred).

Quality Standards 

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. 

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.  

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. 

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. 

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. 

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel between team sites (Paris, the Netherlands, Grenoble/Rennes).

Working Environment 

Office / Hybrid. Paris, Île-de-France, France.

Physical Demands 

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Salary:

Dependent upon experience

50,000-80,000 EURO

title: Lead AI engineer - Freelance
original_description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Solution Architect
original_description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


What You Will Do:
  • Proactively engage with and reache out to customer technical decision-makers and influencers. Utilizy information on customer business, industry, needs, competitive landscape, and key priorities to support the customer's digital transformation.
  • Run data workshops to build plans for implementing solutions that align with customer business goals and technical environments.
  • Drive pilots, proofs of concept (POC), and value (e.g., optimizing solutions and costs) and moves the customer forward from pilots to productive deployments by rooting pilots in business impact.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues reported by customers during the implementation and ongoing campaign deployment process and provide solutions.
  • Identify, escalate, and work to resolve technical blockers (e.g., changing configurations, sample coding) to accelerate architecture implementations, and route non-technical issues for removal by appropriate parties.
  • Proactively engage with product and support teams (e.g., engineering) to remediate blockers by conveying impact.
  • Leverage best practices to guide customer strategy and future growth for Insider One by cultivating customer affinity with Insider One solutions that drive impact for the customer.

    • What You Will Need:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in consultative/complex technical deployment projects, architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of highly distributed applications.
  • Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to orchestrate, lead, and influence virtual teams, ensuring the successful implementation of customer projects.
  • Extensive technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, and technology management.
  • Familiarity, awareness, or strong working knowledge of development methodologies and technologies in one or more of the following: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS; REST, XML, database technologies.
  • You have strong product command and technical domain knowledge of one or more of the following: SaaS, Marketing, Mobile Applications, APIs, or Programming.
  • Strong communication skills in English and French.

    • What We Offer:
  • A chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment,
  • “Tech Talks” with famous and groundbreaking people from the software world,
  • To be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences. Don't believe us? Just ask Google.
  • Access and opportunity to gain a limitless network all over the globe
  • Access to many hard and soft skills pieces of training to help you improve and challenge yourself. 
  • Access to 16,000+ online courses taught by real-world professionals on the LinkedIn Learning platform to satisfy your hunger for knowledge.
  • Space to share your skills through training sessions and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring!
  • Inclusive Private Health Insurance,
  • Smart Work Model side benefits to support food and bill expenses,
  • FUn with the occasional team activities!
  • No Dress Code!
    • We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

    Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
original_description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
original_description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de notre département R&D, vous rejoignez l’équipe Studio, en charge du développement de notre outil de conception et de configuration d’entrepôts robotisés.

De la modélisation d’un entrepôt en 3D au dimensionnement d’une solution Skypod (solution robotisée de stockage et de préparation de commandes pour les entrepôts logistiques), en passant par l’optimisation des coûts et la préparation du déploiement, Studio accompagne les équipes Exotec à chaque étape de leurs projets.

En tant que Senior Java Software Engineer, vous contribuez à faire évoluer cet outil stratégique en concevant et développant son backend et ses API. Vous intervenez sur des problématiques techniques variées, allant des moteurs de règles métier aux intégrations avec l’écosystème Exotec, avec un objectif : proposer des solutions fiables, performantes et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.

En lien étroit avec les équipes techniques, produit et métier, vous participez activement aux choix de conception et à l’amélioration continue de Studio, afin de faciliter la conception et le déploiement des solutions robotiques Exotec à travers le monde.

Vos missions

  • Développer le backend de Studio : concevoir et faire évoluer les services Java et Spring Boot, les API et les fonctionnalités liées à la conception 3D, au dimensionnement des solutions et au calcul des coûts.
  • Concevoir les intégrations : développer et maintenir les connecteurs avec les outils de chiffrage, AutoCAD et les API de l’écosystème Exotec, notamment ICT et MCP.
  • Garantir la qualité du produit : assurer la performance, la robustesse et la fiabilité des applications, analyser les incidents de production et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du code.
  • Contribuer à la livraison continue : participer aux processus CI/CD, aux releases et à la validation des évolutions avec GitLab.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes : recueillir les besoins des utilisateurs, travailler avec les équipes produit, frontend, commerciales et projets, et participer aux rituels agiles de l’équipe.

Profil

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en informatique ou en informatique industrielle, et justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement web.

Vous disposez des compétences suivantes :

  • Vous maîtrisez Java et l’écosystème JEE, notamment Spring et Spring Boot.
  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance des technologies web et de la conception d’API.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL, ainsi qu’avec les environnements Linux.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de gestion de versions et de développement collaboratif, notamment GitLab.
  • Vous connaissez idéalement un framework JavaScript, tel que React ou Vue.js.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel.

Structuré(e), rigoureux(se) et imaginatif(ve), vous savez prendre des initiatives et proposer des solutions pragmatiques. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes à l’aise pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, dans un environnement de travail convivial.

Poste soumis à astreinte.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

title: Reliability Engineer
original_description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec.

Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels.

À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes.

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes :

  • Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives.
  • Développer des outils d’analyse : concevoir vos propres outils software pour exploiter les données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et évaluer les performances des systèmes.
  • Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software.
  • Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware.
  • Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées.
  • Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration.

Votre profil

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure technique en mécatronique, systèmes embarqués, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou vous avez acquis une expérience équivalente.
  • Vous avez une expérience en conception, développement ou validation de systèmes techniques et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche de panne et l’analyse des causes racines.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données.
  • Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre software et hardware et êtes capable de comprendre les interactions entre les différents composants d’un système.
  • Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les méthodes quantitatives appliquées à la fiabilité : MTTF, MTBF, loi de Weibull ou analyse statistique des défaillances.
  • Vous êtes curieux(se), structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), avec une approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes.
  • Vous savez remettre en question vos hypothèses, approfondir vos analyses et rechercher de nouvelles connaissances lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Vous aimez collaborer avec des ingénieurs aux expertises variées, qu’elles soient orientées hardware, software ou systèmes.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

title: Backend Engineer Intern (6 months starting February 2027)
original_description:
👫 About the team

At Equativ, we’re on a mission to develop advertising technologies that empower our customers to reach their digital business goals. This means that we rely on massively scalable, widely distributed, highly available, and efficient software systems; the platform deals with over 6 million requests per second (+500 billion/day) handled by 3,500+ instances with less than 250ms response time.

Our innovation team based in Paris, Nantes, Limoges, Montreal, Krakow and Berlin is composed of 190+ straightforward and energetic engineers working in an agile environment and ready to tackle the most complex technical challenges.


👇 Your mission
You will join our fast-growing R&D within the exchange backend development teams. Your specific team’s mission is to improve our ad exchange platform seeking better performance, higher maintainability and faster scalability. As a member of the team, you’ll get to work on production challenges, whether they are short-term focused (e.g. improving an algo to save CPU) or shaping the future of our platform (e.g. scaling it for the cloud).  As an intern, you’ll get to learn and grow within an international team composed of several areas of expertise. You will join the Auctioning feature team, made up of 5 developers, a Product Owner and a QA engineer, working at the heart of our real-time auction engine. You’ll report directly to a Senior Engineer in this team.

What you'll do ✏️

  • Work in an agile, international and multi-expertise team composed of software engineers, QA and DevOps.

  • Ship your applications with GitLab and ArgoCD/Kubernetes.

  • Improve our end-to-end test reliability and tooling.

  • Participate in maintaining our stack to the newest .NET release.

  • Participate in our daily features development.

  • Monitor your features in production with Grafana and Datadog.

  • Work on data flows with Kafka, Aerospike, SQL Server and BigQuery.

  • Develop with Claude Code and help improve our AI efficiency.

  • Learn a lot by working on one of the biggest productions of French tech!


About you 💪

Must have:

  • Master’s or engineering-school student looking for an internship.

  • Professional efficiency in verbal and written English.

  • Serious doubts about the saying “Testing is Doubting”.

  • Passion for writing, reviewing and judging high-quality and maintainable code following agile principles.

  • Appetite for learning and technical challenge.

  • Coding skills with object-oriented programming (C#, Java, C++…).

  • SQL basics. 

    • Nice to have:

    • Experience with modern .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core).

    • Curiosity about performance and low-level .NET (memory, GC).

    • Interest in distributed systems and cloud development.

    • Personal projects with code sharing, we’re curious about your art!

title: Stage - Data Engineer - ML (H/F)
original_description:
Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé.

Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil…
Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain.

Votre mission
L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs.
Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de :

  • Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents.
  • Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non).
  • Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes.
  • Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés.

Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale.
Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage.

Requirements

  • Connaissances théoriques en traitement du signal et en machine learning
  • Compétences informatiques : programmation en Python, première expérience en framework deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) appréciée
  • Bonus : programmation en C
  • Intérêt pour le machine learning
  • Intérêt pour les applications en santé connectée
  • Lecture de l'anglais scientifique et technique
  • Capacité rédactionnelle, de rigueur et d'autonomie
  • Aptitude pour le travail en équipe et communication
  • Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Assister à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

title: Senior Data Engineer
original_description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap, la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte, dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.


👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.


💪 Tes missions

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

  • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.
  • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
  • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
  • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
  • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille
  • Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.
  • Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.
  • Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.
  • Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.
  • L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.
  • Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

    • ⭐ Notre stack
    • GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
    • Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
    • Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
    • IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
    • Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
    • IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

    🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

    Indispensable

    • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production.
    • SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).
    • Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.
    • Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.
    • Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.
    • Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.
    • Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.
    • Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote.
    • Anglais B2 minimum.

      • Un gros plus

      • Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.
      • Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

        • Un plus

        • Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.
        • Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).
        • Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).
        • Pipelines data en Change Data Capture.
        • Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

    🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays.
    • Une Data Platform avec un vrai scope stratégique (reporting, IA, data gouvernance) et des sujets de fond pour les 2 prochaines année.
    • Rémunération : 60K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • Full remote  — venues à Lyon ponctuelles pour les moments d'équipe.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib / EGYM wellpass, et plus.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement
    1. Screening avec notre Senior Talent Acquisition — 45 min sur ton parcours et ta motivation.
    2. 1er entretien technique avec Pauline (Head of Data) — discussion technique, challenge sur la manière d'aborder des problèmes, cadrage de sujets, use case Agicap — 1h.
    3. 2ème entretien technique avec Kévin (Team Lead DE) et Julien — test SQL + test d'architecture oral + discussion technique + cas IA — 2h.
    Feedback rapide à chaque étape. Process transparent, pas de piège.
    AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

title: Développeur Full Stack Station F || 6 mois
original_description:
Intersektion, c’est une startup tech engagée qui accompagne les entreprises dans le pilotage de leurs démarches RSE, qualité et durabilité. Nous développons une plateforme SaaS innovante permettant de centraliser les données ESG, automatiser le reporting, piloter des plans d’action et répondre à différents référentiels et normes.

Tu veux avoir un vrai impact ? Coder sur des sujets concrets qui comptent ? Voir les fonctionnalités que tu développes utilisées rapidement par des entreprises et des experts RSE ? Ce stage est fait pour toi.

On est une petite équipe très soudée, bienveillante, qui avance vite. Sur 6 mois, l’objectif est de te permettre de prendre progressivement la responsabilité de vrais sujets produit et techniques. Tu ne seras pas un·e stagiaire planqué·e derrière une doc Notion jamais mise à jour : tu seras intégré·e comme un·e membre à part entière de l’équipe produit.

Vos missions

En lien direct avec les fondateurs et les utilisateurs, tu participeras activement à toutes les étapes du développement produit :

  • Développement front-end et back-end
  • Conception et développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités : dashboards de pilotage, reporting RSE, gestion documentaire, systèmes de scoring, automatisations…
  • Connexion et intégration d’APIs externes
  • Amélioration continue de l’UX/UI et contribution à la roadmap produit
  • Développement de fonctionnalités autour de la collecte, du traitement et de la visualisation de données
  • Implémentation de modules d’analyse : calculs de KPI, benchmarks, indicateurs et tableaux de bord
  • Participation aux choix techniques et à l’évolution de l’architecture du produit
  • Développement et intégration de fonctionnalités basées sur l’IA : analyse documentaire, extraction de données, génération de contenu, assistants intelligents…
  • Tests, débogage et amélioration continue des fonctionnalités existantes
  • Échanges avec les utilisateurs pour comprendre leurs besoins et les transformer en fonctionnalités concrètes

Sur 6 mois, tu auras la possibilité de prendre en charge plusieurs projets de bout en bout : compréhension du besoin, réflexion produit, développement, mise en production et amélioration à partir des retours utilisateurs.

Vos compétences

Tu n’as pas besoin d’avoir 10 ans d’expérience, mais on attend de toi :

  • Une bonne maîtrise du développement web : JavaScript, Node.js, Python ou un langage backend équivalent
  • De bonnes bases en API REST et en bases de données
  • Une compréhension des problématiques front-end et back-end
  • Une vraie curiosité technique et l’envie d’apprendre rapidement
  • Une capacité à chercher, tester et résoudre des problèmes de manière autonome
  • L’envie de construire des fonctionnalités concrètes plutôt que de rester dans la théorie
  • Une forte autonomie et une appétence pour les environnements startup
  • Un intérêt pour l’IA, la data, la RSE, la durabilité ou la tech for good est un vrai plus, mais n’est pas obligatoire

On cherche surtout quelqu’un qui aime comprendre, construire, tester et itérer.

Avantages

Un vrai rôle dans le développement d’un produit utilisé quotidiennement par des clients réels6 mois pour monter en puissance et devenir autonome sur des sujets completsDes fonctionnalités mises en production rapidement : tu verras concrètement l’impact de ton travailUne proximité directe avec les fondateurs, les utilisateurs et les décisions produitUne culture d’équipe bienveillante : tu seras écouté·e, challengé·e et responsabilisé·eUne montée en compétences rapide sur des sujets techniques, IA, produit et stratégiquesUne expérience complète du développement d’un SaaS en environnement startupUn environnement de travail au cœur de l’écosystème startup à Station FEt surtout : la sensation de bosser pour un projet qui a du sens

Ce stage est une opportunité si tu veux passer 6 mois à construire réellement un produit tech, plutôt qu’à travailler sur un projet isolé qui ne verra jamais la production.

Si tu aimes coder, proposer, inventer, itérer et prendre progressivement des responsabilités, Intersektion t’ouvre grand les bras

title: Valve Lead Engineer
original_description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Senior Valve Engineer (Technical Authority) based in Toulouse.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on valve expert who will serve as Pangea’s company-wide technical authority for valves. The mission is to build the internal capability to specify, design, analyse, source, test, qualify, industrialise, and continuously improve critical valves for our propulsion systems.

The first priority will be to assess and internalise selected valves used on Nereus, starting where technically and commercially justified with HTP-compatible valves. The scope can then expand to other valve families and propulsion programmes based on risk, recurring cost, lead time, supply-chain dependence, and strategic value.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with strong technical leadership. You will work closely with Fluidics and across Systems, Design, Analysis, Materials, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations, taking decisions from first principles and carrying them through to validated hardware.

Key responsibilities

· Act as Pangea’s technical reference for valves, owning design decisions, technical reviews, risk acceptance, and the valve technology roadmap across propulsion programmes.

· Define the valve internalisation strategy and prioritise candidates using performance, safety, development risk, recurring cost, lead time, supplier dependence, and manufacturing scalability.

· Lead the initial Nereus workstream for HTP-compatible solenoid valves: capture requirements and interfaces; benchmark make-versus-buy options; select concepts; and define the development and qualification plan.

· Own the full product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, trade-offs, detailed design, analysis, materials and sealing selection through prototyping, testing, qualification, production release, and in-service improvement.

· Develop or approve valve sizing and dynamic models covering flow capacity and pressure drop, actuation force and margin, response time, leakage, thermal effects, friction, hysteresis, fatigue, wear, contamination sensitivity, and lifetime.

· Establish verification logic, acceptance criteria, instrumentation, test matrices, and qualification evidence for nominal, off-nominal, proof, endurance, environmental, and compatibility testing.

· Ensure compatibility with HTP and, as applicable, cryogenic, high-pressure, hot, reactive, or hazardous fluids through disciplined materials, cleanliness, sealing, lubrication, and contamination-control choices.

· Resolve difficult hardware problems through structured failure investigation, test-data interpretation, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and design iteration.

· Lead technical engagement with valve, actuator, coil, seal, and manufacturing suppliers; review proposals, drawings, analyses, process controls, inspection plans, qualification evidence, deviations, and non-conformances.

· Create reusable internal standards, design rules, calculation methods, test procedures, lessons learned, and product architectures, while mentoring engineers and raising valve competence across the company.

Initial Mandate

Build a credible make-versus-buy and development plan for Nereus HTP-compatible solenoid valves, close the highest-risk knowledge gaps with analysis and testing, and leave behind a repeatable internal valve-development capability.

What you need to be successful

Education

· Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, Fluid Mechanics, or a closely related engineering discipline.

· Additional specialization in fluid systems, cryogenics, mechanical design, tribology, sealing technology, materials, or control systems would be advantageous.

Experience

· 8 to 10 years or more of relevant engineering experience, with substantial direct ownership of valve or closely related fluid-control hardware.

· Demonstrated hands-on delivery of hardware from requirements and concept selection through detailed design, test, qualification, and production support.

· Deep experience with solenoid, pilot-operated, pneumatic, electro-mechanical, or comparable valves for demanding applications.

· Experience with high-pressure, reactive, hazardous, cryogenic, or high-temperature fluid systems; liquid rocket propulsion or space hardware experience is strongly preferred.

· Evidence of solving real valve failure modes and working directly with manufacturing, suppliers, inspection teams, test facilities, and non-conformance processes.

Technical expertise

· Strong command of valve architecture, fluid mechanics, actuation, sealing, tribology, tolerancing, material selection, cleanliness, and design for manufacture and assembly.

· Ability to size and analyse valves using appropriate analytical and numerical methods, and to correlate models with component and system test data.

· Proven capability investigating leakage, friction, hysteresis, pressure drop, response time, actuation margin, contamination, wear, fatigue, thermal effects, and lifetime.

· Working knowledge of qualification logic, reliability, FMEA, fracture and fatigue considerations, configuration control, and technical documentation for safety-critical hardware.

· Knowledge of HTP compatibility, decomposition hazards, compatible materials and seals, cleanliness, and safe test practices is highly valuable.

Leadership

· Strong technical ownership: comfortable making and documenting difficult decisions, while actively seeking challenge and evidence.

· System-level thinking, with the ability to connect valve behaviour to engine, propulsion-system, test-bench, and vehicle performance.

· Pragmatic judgement that balances technical excellence with safety, schedule, cost, manufacturability, maintainability, and qualification effort.

· Clear communication across disciplines and with suppliers, including the ability to turn ambiguous problems into structured plans and crisp technical requirements.

· Builder’s mindset: equally willing to work at a whiteboard, review a drawing, analyse data, inspect hardware, and support a test campaign.

Additional assets

Advanced education: Postgraduate specialisation in fluid mechanics, cryogenics, sealing, tribology, mechatronics, controls, or mechanical design.

Relevant sectors: Space propulsion, aerospace, energy, hydrogen, oil and gas, chemical processing, or other high-pressure and hazardous-fluid industries.

Specialised expertise: HTP service, cryogenic valves, high-pressure solenoid valves, pilot-operated architectures, sealing technologies, actuation systems, materials compatibility, cleanliness, or lifetime qualification.
